items.exampleZh: 我奶奶做的餅乾很好吃。

items.exampleEn: I have a sandwich for lunch.
The waiter brings us some water.
items.exampleZh: 服務生幫我們拿來一些水。

items.exampleEn: Let's meet at the cafe near the station.
items.exampleZh: 我們在車站附近的咖啡店碰面吧。

items.sentenceEn: Can I have a cheese sandwich?
items.sentenceZh: 可以給我一份起司三明治嗎？

items.audioEn: Excuse me, waiter. Can we have two pizzas, please?
items.audioZh: 服務生，不好意思，可以給我們兩個披薩嗎？

items.sentenceEn: The cookies at this cafe are delicious.
items.sentenceZh: 這家咖啡店的餅乾很好吃。

items.stemEn: The ____ brings our food to the table. He is very nice.
items.stemZh: 服務生把我們的食物送到桌上，他人很好。

items.stemEn: This pizza is ____! Can I have one more piece?
items.stemZh: 這個披薩好好吃！我可以再吃一塊嗎？

items.passageEn: There is a new cafe on my street. It has sandwiches, pizza, and cookies. The sandwiches are delicious, and the cookies are free with every coffee! The waiter and the waitress are very nice. I go there every Saturday.
items.passageZh: 我住的那條街上開了一家新的咖啡店，有三明治、披薩和餅乾。三明治很好吃，而且每買一杯咖啡就送餅乾！男服務生和女服務生都很親切。我每個星期六都去。

questions.questionZh: 在這家咖啡店，買咖啡會送什麼？

rubricZh: 「很好吃」可用 delicious、very good、tastes good 等

items.promptZh: 那家咖啡店的老闆很年輕。
referenceEn: The owner of that cafe is very young.
That cafe's owner is very young.
rubricZh: 「那家咖啡店的老闆」可寫，例如 the owner of that cafe、that cafe's owner 等
「很年輕」可寫，例如 young、very young 等
